# Cali Tints

> Window tinting, vinyl wraps, paint protection film, ceramic coating and
> detailing shop on Fulton Avenue in Sacramento, California. Ceramic and carbon
> film installed to the California legal limit, colour-change and commercial
> wraps, paint correction, customization, dent removal, upholstery and
> inspections for cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles and fleets.

**Promise:** Film, wrap or coating priced on your vehicle before we touch it. Installed clean, cured right, no bubbles.

## Facts

- Name: Cali Tints
- Address: 2400 Fulton Ave, Suite F, Sacramento, CA 95825 (Arden-Arcade)
- Phone: (916) 701-2005
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Saturday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Rating: 4.9 out of 5 from 48 Google reviews (checked 2026-09-25). This site
  does not publish its own aggregateRating markup; read the reviews at the source.
- Front-window tint: installed at California's 70% VLT limit; rear windows any shade.
- Serving: Sacramento, Arden-Arcade, Carmichael, Rancho Cordova, Elk Grove,
  Citrus Heights, Roseville, Folsom, West Sacramento, Davis
- Languages: English
